explication: OpenStock is a stock research and watchlist web app. Users search for a symbol, open its market and company information, and can manage personal watchlists and alerts; authentication and onboarding personalize that experience. The graph also preserves documented market-overview, sentiment, and scheduled email capabilities. The tree, README, and sampled files support these boundaries, but unsampled page and automation implementations limit certainty about some wiring.
